name: Beef Broth (RtP)
description: Kaldu daging sapi dengan perbandingan 1:1 (1kg tulang dan 1 kg air).

prep.title: Rinse
prep.text: with room temp. water (1-2 min/kg). Pat dry or air dry to prevent uneven browning.

ingredients.name: Knuckle/joint bones/femur
ingredients.description: Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Marrow bones
ingredients.description: Tulang sumsum. More is better. Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Neck bones
ingredients.description: Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Filtered Water
ingredients.description: Compensating evaporation during cooking process. 30% more.

procedures.title: Roasting
procedures.instructions: 200°C, 30-40 min, golden brown. Aluminum foil underneath. Turn once halfway.
procedures.tools: Could set to highest temp. with shorter time

procedures.title: Parboil
procedures.instructions: Start boiling. Heat to 100°C, then 3-5 min, just enough water. Stir occationally. Dump water.

procedures.title: Rinse
procedures.instructions: 40-50°C high-pressure water. Only clean surface briefly.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions: 24 hrs. Start cold, heat to below simmering (92 C). Skim in first 30-60 mins. Slightly open the lid.
procedures.tools: Clean stockpot, filtered water. Use induction or slow cooker if left alone.

options.label: Immediate use
options.text: Scoop the beef broth and skim the beef tallow. Keep broth ≥ 60°C.

options.label: Store
options.text: Immediately cool down until 21°C within 2 hr using ice bath, to 5°C within next 4 hr in the freezer. Label production date. Thaw in fridge before use.

finish.title: Beef tallow
finish.text: After storing the broth in the fridge, a golden layer will be formed on top. Scrape this and store as Beef Tallow, useful later. When used immediately, skim the fat layer and store it.

notes.title: Shimmering durations
notes.body: Meaty flavor extraction and gelatin extraction has different timetable.

notes.title: Narrow pot
notes.body: Narrow pot helps for small-scale production

notes.title: Reverse Osmosis Water
notes.body: Is the best quality water for this kind of food. Carbon filter is also fine.

notes.title: Oil on roasting
notes.body: Unnecessary, burdening cost and potentially leaving greasy-film on the broth.

notes.title: Roasting liquids
notes.body: Pour on heatproof cup and let it sit for 2-3 mins. Strain golden top layer as a beef tallow. Discard black residue. Add darker juice to the broth. Deglaze brown bits (using the water for broth, do not add more) and add to broth (not when parboiling).

notes.title: Simmer temperature
notes.body: Should not see steam breaking the surface. Tony bubbles. Never rolling boil. Do not add too much water (max 12%).
